description: This file contains shell script functions and test cases for managing and testing git submodule operations, including creating repositories, switching between commits, and verifying submodule states.

methods.name: create_lib_submodule_repo
methods.description: Creates a set of git repositories with submodules for testing various submodule operations.

methods.name: replace_gitfile_with_git_dir
methods.description: Replaces a .git file with a .git directory in a submodule.

methods.name: test_git_directory_is_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that the .git directory in a submodule remains unchanged except for core.worktree.

methods.name: test_git_directory_exists
methods.description: Verifies the existence of the .git directory in a submodule.

methods.name: prolog
methods.description: Sets up global git configuration and creates the repository structure if needed.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to
methods.description: Resets the working tree to a specific commit and initializes submodules accordingly.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to_interested
methods.description: Resets the working tree to a specific commit and prepares submodules for testing.

methods.name: test_superproject_content
methods.description: Verifies that the superproject's working tree matches a specific commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_content
methods.description: Verifies that a submodule's content matches the commit recorded in the superproject.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_common
methods.description: Internal function to test submodule switch operations under various conditions.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: Tests submodule switch operations with a given command.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch
methods.description: Tests submodule switch operations using 'git' command.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch
methods.description: Tests forced submodule switch operations allowing local changes to be discarded.

methods.name: test_submodule_recursing_with_args_common
methods.description: Internal function to test recursive submodule switch operations.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Tests recursive submodule switch with specific git command arguments.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Tests forced recursive submodule switch with specific git command arguments.
